headline: OKX Bitcoin Spot Taker Flow Flips To A 204.92 Bitcoin Buy Imbalance
narrative: Aggressive buy volume minus aggressive sell volume on OKX bitcoin spot sums to 204.92 bitcoin over the last 24 hours, compared with a negative 13.975 bitcoin reading on the prior print. That window ranks in the 75.1 percentile of its own 30-day windows, compared with the 50.0 percentile on that print, and the reading is buy-side leaning after a balanced print. A positive print means aggressive buyers lifted more bitcoin than aggressive sellers hit on that spot venue, and a negative print means aggressive sellers hit more.
author: jordan
